organization.title: Organization
organization.subtitle: Entity registry, organizational structure and privacy roles

entity.title: Entity registry
entity.not_configured: Entity not configured yet: fill in the form and save.
entity.name: Name

roles.name: Name
roles.unit_required: Select a unit for this scope

dashboard.title: Control room
dashboard.subtitle: Factual overview of the entity's processing activities. No compliance score.

register.title: Record of processing activities
register.subtitle: Single source of truth for processing activities (GDPR Art. 30). Each fact is recorded once.
register.no_versions: No snapshots yet. One is created on each edit or status change.
register.confirm_delete: Delete this draft? Approved activities are archived, not deleted.

fields.title: Title
fields.purposes_hint: Each line is a distinct purpose of the processing

assets.title: Systems and assets
assets.subtitle: Single inventory of applications, databases, cloud and archives. Linkable to processing activities.
assets.name: Name

parties.title: Suppliers and processors
parties.subtitle: Single party registry. The Art. 28 act is a documentary checklist, not a compliance score.
parties.name: Legal name

import.title: Import register from Excel/CSV
import.subtitle: Guided migration of existing processing activities: only draft records are created, to be reviewed.
import.upload_hint: Select an .xlsx or .csv file (max 10 MB, 2000 rows). Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.mapping_hint: Map the file columns to register fields. Title is required.
import.duplicate_column: The same column is mapped to several fields.
import.skip_invalid: Skip invalid rows instead of blocking the import
import.blocked: There are invalid rows: fix the file or choose to skip them.
import.drafts_note: Imported activities are created as Draft with source "legacy import"; unrecognized values are kept in the import notes. No supplier, system or catalog records are created.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Approval requests for processing activities and DPIAs. Each decision is bound to the version submitted for review.

dialog.note_required: The note is required and will be visible to the requester.

policy.title: Entity policy
policy.subtitle: Permissions per role and segregation-of-duties rules. Changes apply to every user of the entity.

segregation.title: Segregation of duties
segregation.hint: Each entity decides which separations apply. None is active by default.

rules.approver_not_requester: Whoever submitted a request cannot approve it
rules.approver_not_editor: Whoever edited the content cannot approve it

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.hint: Each box shows which roles may perform the action. Super admin and Tenant admin always keep every permission; locked rows cannot be changed.

status_notes.submit_hint: Optional: the note will be visible to the approver.
status_notes.back_hint: A note is required when you request changes to someone else's request; it is optional when you withdraw your own.
status_notes.approve_hint: Optional: the note is kept in the approval history.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.trigger_hint: E.g. end of the relationship; required when the period depends on an event.

supply.title: Supply chain
supply.subtitle: Supplier contracts and the chain of sub-processors (GDPR art. 28).
supply.countries_hint: Two-letter ISO codes separated by commas (e.g. IT, DE).

findings.title: Checks
findings.subtitle: Issues detected on current data: art. 28 agreements, contracts, sub-processors and retention. Recomputed every time you open the page.

dialog.accept_hint: A reason is required and kept in the history: the finding will not reopen while the condition persists.

why.title: Why am I seeing this finding?
why.changed: The rule has changed (version {{current}}). Current condition:

rules.hint: Each entity can disable rules and change their severity and parameters. Every change creates a new version; existing findings keep the original one.
rules.name: Rule

codes.BREACH_NOTIFICATION_DECISION_MISSING: {{hours}} hours have passed since breach {{breach}} was known and no decision on notifying the authority is recorded
codes.NOTICE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Processing {{processing}} changed after notice {{notice}} was approved. Check consistency on: {{fields}}
codes.NOTICE_REVIEW_CONTROLLER: The controller or DPO details changed after notice {{notice}} was approved: check the contact details
codes.DATA_FLOW_UNLINKED_ENDPOINT: A flow of processing {{processing}} involves {{endpoint}}, which is not linked to the processing
codes.RISK_ASSESSMENT_REVIEW: Processing {{processing}} handles special categories of data without a risk assessment
codes.PROCESSING_REVIEW_DUE: Processing {{processing}} was due for review by {{date}}
codes.ASSET_DISMISSED_CHECKLIST: System {{asset}} was retired: complete the checklist ({{open_tasks}} open tasks)
codes.PROCESSOR_NO_VALID_AGREEMENT: Processing {{processing}} uses processor {{party}} without a valid art. 28 agreement
codes.AGREEMENT_EXPIRED: The art. 28 agreement with {{party}} expired on {{date}}
codes.AGREEMENT_EXPIRING: The art. 28 agreement with {{party}} expires on {{date}}
codes.CONTRACT_EXPIRING: Contract {{contract}} with {{party}} expires or renews on {{date}}
codes.SUBPROCESSOR_EXPIRED: The authorization of {{subprocessor}} as sub-processor of {{processor}} has expired
codes.SUBPROCESSOR_NO_CLAUSE: The art. 28 agreement with {{processor}} has no sub-processor clause

notices.title: Privacy notices
notices.subtitle: Privacy notices with immutable approved versions, linked to processing activities. If a linked processing changes after approval a review finding appears.
notices.name: Title
notices.new_version_hint: Starts from the text in force. The approved version stays in force until the new one is approved.
notices.confirm_review_hint: Confirms the notice is still consistent with the linked processing activities without creating a new version. The note is kept in the history.

hints.aware_at: When the entity became aware of it. It can only be corrected with a reason, and the original stays visible.
hints.requester_reference: Opaque reference (e.g. protocol number): it does not appear in audit, notifications or events.
hints.validity_months: Months of validity after completion; empty = no expiry. Drives the renewal.
hints.user_ids: User identifiers, separated by comma or new line.
hints.opinion_notes: The context of the request. It does not appear in audit or events.
hints.go_live_date: Only at the approval decision; empty = today. The post-implementation review (6 months) is computed from it.
hints.cf_key: Lowercase, digits and underscore; cannot change after creation.
hints.cf_options: Only for choice fields: one value per line.

legalref.title: Legal references
legalref.subtitle: The entity's catalog of laws and acts cited by processing activities and retention rules.

actions.title: Corrective actions
actions.subtitle: Actions with an owner and due date, from audits, DPIAs, breaches or recommendations. Overdue actions raise a check.

breaches.title: Data breaches
breaches.subtitle: Register of all breaches, including those not notified. Elapsed time is indicative and does not decide whether notification is required.

requests.title: Data subject requests
requests.subtitle: Access, rectification, erasure and other rights requests, with response deadline and extension.

audits.title: Audits
audits.subtitle: Planning and execution of audits, with findings that can be linked to corrective actions.

training.title: Training
training.subtitle: Courses, sessions and assignments. Overdue mandatory assignments raise a check.

trainingAssignments.title: Training assignments
trainingAssignments.subtitle: Who must attend which course and where they stand. Without the management permission you only see your own.

authorizations.title: Authorized persons
authorizations.subtitle: Who is authorized to process the data of a processing activity or system, with which profile and for how long. Authorizations are revoked, never deleted.

authProfiles.title: Authorization profiles
authProfiles.subtitle: Assignable access levels (e.g. read, edit, administer).

opinions.title: DPO opinions
opinions.subtitle: Opinion requests and issued opinions, kept apart from the controller's decisions.

projects.title: Privacy by design
projects.subtitle: New projects with privacy, ICT and DPO review, DPIA if needed, approval, go-live and post-implementation review. At the DPIA stage the register items can be generated.

tags.title: Tags
tags.subtitle: Cross-cutting labels (e.g. PNRR, minors, health, cloud) to group and find elements. A tag in use is deactivated, not deleted.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.subtitle: A few extra fields for some element types (max 20 per type). They do not replace the model: key and type never change; a field with values is deactivated, not deleted.

documents.title: Documents and evidence
documents.subtitle: Metadata kept separate from the file. Each upload creates a new version (SHA-256).

tasks.title: Tasks and deadlines
tasks.subtitle: Work planning. OVERDUE is computed from the due date.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Append-only log of domain actions. It cannot be edited or deleted.

catalogsPage.title: Catalogues
catalogsPage.subtitle: Global templates are read-only; you can add entity-local entries.
catalogsPage.name: Name

dpia.title: DPIA
dpia.subtitle: Data protection impact assessment. Screening suggests whether to proceed; the decision stays human and reasoned.
dpia.no_risks: No structured assessments yet. Add them from Risks and measures.

tia.title: International transfers and TIA
tia.subtitle: Transfers outside the EEA. The TIA sits on the transfer, not a second register. Extra-EEA without adequacy → TIA required.

risk.title: Risks and measures
risk.subtitle: Configurable 1–5 matrix per entity. No rating without a rationale. Measures reduce residual risk.
risk.matrix_hint: Score = likelihood × impact. Bands belong to the tenant, not a GDPR compliance score.

search.title: Global search
search.placeholder: Search by code, title, description or tag…
search.none: No results among the items you can access.

opinions.separate_note: The DPO's opinion is separate from the controller's decision and cannot be changed once issued.

workspace.title: DPO workspace
workspace.subtitle: What needs the DPO's attention, within the units in scope.

report.title: Annual report
report.subtitle: Data and statistics are computed by the system; comments and conclusions belong to the responsible person. Finalizing also freezes the data.
report.confirm_finalize: Finalizing freezes the data and locks the comments (until reopened). Continue?
report.reopened: Report reopened: data is live again.

labels.due_in_year: Due for review in the year
labels.avg_hours_to_notification: Average hours from awareness to notification

projects.assessment_risky: The declared characteristics require the DPO's review and a DPIA screening.
projects.assessment_plain: No characteristic requires the DPO's review or a DPIA: the project goes from privacy and ICT review straight to approval.

artifacts.title: Generated items
artifacts.none: No items generated yet. From the DPIA stage on you can generate processing, system, contract, art. 28 agreement, notice and tasks.

annotations.title: Tags, fields and comments
annotations.comments_hint: Working notes: formal decisions (approvals, opinions, outcomes) have their own fields and workflow and must not be written here.
annotations.no_tagged: No visible element carries this tag.

visibility.ALL_AUTHORIZED: Anyone who can see the element

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality, watermark and step-up
confidentiality.subtitle: Rules for the "restricted" and "highly restricted" levels of documents, breaches, DPIAs and projects. The author and administrators always read what they created.
confidentiality.roles_hint: Roles that read elements of this level (administrators are always included).
confidentiality.block_bulk_export: Exclude from the tenant's full export
confidentiality.step_up_hint: The server checks the token claims (amr/acr and auth_time): the Portal or IdP must issue them after a real multi-factor authentication.
confidentiality.admin_actions: Require MFA for sensitive administrative actions (SUPER_ADMIN, export, retention, webhooks)

query.title: Queries
query.subtitle: Build a search with conditions on one type of item (for example: data category = HEALTH and no DPIA). You only see what you can already access.
query.no_conditions: No conditions: every visible item is listed.
query.exported_excluded: Export completed: {{count}} confidential items are not included.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Send events to an external system (for example the reminder product) with a signed HTTPS request. The content is minimal: item type and id, status and useful dates; the receiver reads the rest from the API.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.url_hint: HTTPS and public addresses only, unless the system administrator allows the host.
webhooks.payload_hint: Every request is signed: X-PrivacyPA-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.body"). Receivers use X-PrivacyPA-Delivery as an idempotency key.
webhooks.confirm_rotate: Regenerate the secret? The current one stops working immediately: update the receiver.
webhooks.confirm_delete: Delete the endpoint and its delivery history?
webhooks.secret_once: The secret is only shown now: copy it and keep it safe, it will not be shown again.

event_desc.processing.updated: A processing activity changed (creation, data, status, relations)
event_desc.processor.expiring: An art. 28 agreement or a contract is about to expire
event_desc.task.overdue: A task is past its due date
event_desc.dpia.review_due: A DPIA needs to be reviewed
event_desc.document.expiring: A document's current version is about to expire
event_desc.finding.opened: A compliance finding was opened (any rule)

deadlines.title: Relative deadlines
deadlines.subtitle: Calendar months (not 30 days, nor 365 days per year). On first approval, or when the previous review has expired, the next review date is calculated from the approval; a future date entered by hand is not moved. 0 turns automatic calculation off. Reminders for contracts and agreements are set in the compliance rule parameters.
